notes.title: May 2025 Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]May 2025 Playtest - The 555 Release[/h1]

Please send feedback - good or bad - to peccarygames@gmail.com

The first Xenomycology playtest is live!  This is still an extremely early build of the game - please expect bugs and unfinished features. 

[h2]What's Included[/h2]
[list]
[*]Five stages
[*]Five mushroom types
[*]Five types of enemy to slay
[/list]

[h2]What's Unfinished[/h2]
[list]
[*]Many animations are missing frames, or not implemented yet
[*]The UI is very rough
[*]The bulk of the backtracking system hasn't been implemented
[*]The final game will have many more stages and biomes to explore
[/list]
